value: 怪獣8号 (Kaijū Hachigō)
text: Kaiju No. 8 is called Kaijū Hachigō in Japan, and its English alternate title is Monster #8.
excerpt: Kaiju No. 8 (怪獣8号, Kaijū Hachigō), also known in English as Monster #8, is a Japanese web manga series

value: Written and drawn by Naoya Matsumoto for Shōnen Jump+ (Shueisha)
text: Naoya Matsumoto is both writer and artist of the manga, which ran on Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+ from July 3, 2020 until July 18, 2025.
excerpt: written and illustrated by Naoya Matsumoto. It was serialized on Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+ app and website from July 2020 to July 2025

value: 129 chapters in 16 volumes, last volume on September 4, 2025
text: The story closed after 129 chapters collected in 16 volumes, with the final book reaching Japanese shops on September 4, 2025.
excerpt: The 16th and final volume was released on September 4, 2025.

value: Production I.G, director Shigeyuki Miya, 12 episodes, April 13 to June 29, 2024
text: Production I.G animated the first season, with Studio Khara handling the kaiju designs; the 12 episodes ran between April 13 and June 29, 2024.
excerpt: The first season aired from April 13 to June 29, 2024, on TV Tokyo and its affiliates. The series is directed by Shigeyuki Miya and Tomomi Kamiya

value: 11 episodes (overall 13 to 23), July 19 to September 27, 2025
text: Season two followed in July 2025 and brought the anime to 23 episodes in total; its last episode aired on September 27, 2025.
excerpt: A second season was announced in December 2024 at Jump Festa, and aired from July 19 to September 27, 2025.

value: OP 1: Abyss - Yungblud (season 1)
ED 1: Nobody - OneRepublic (season 1)
text: The first season opens with Abyss by Yungblud and closes each episode with Nobody by OneRepublic.
excerpt: For the first season: the opening theme song is "Abyss" performed by Yungblud, while the ending theme song is "Nobody" performed by OneRepublic.

value: OP 2: You Can't Run From Yourself - Aurora (season 2)
ED 2: Beautiful Colors - OneRepublic (season 2)
text: For season two the opening is You Can't Run From Yourself by Aurora, and OneRepublic returns with Beautiful Colors as the ending.
excerpt: the opening theme song is "You Can't Run From Yourself" performed by Aurora, while the ending theme song is "Beautiful Colors" performed by OneRepublic.

value: Defense Force suits are made from kaiju remains; power is rated up to 100%
text: Officers fight in powered suits built from kaiju remains, and each suit shows a combat power percentage that tops out at 100.
excerpt: Defense Force officers wear powered suits made from kaiju remains that grant them increased strength, speed, and durability.

value: Influenced by tokusatsu, especially Ultraman
text: Matsumoto drew on Japanese tokusatsu shows, above all the Ultraman series, and used his own struggles as a manga artist for Kafka's backstory.
excerpt: The series was heavily influenced by Japanese tokusatsu media, especially Ultraman

value: Next Manga Award, web manga category, 2021 (winner); Eisner Award nominee, 2022
text: The manga took the 2021 Next Manga Award for web manga and was shortlisted for an Eisner Award the year after.
excerpt: The series won the Next Manga Award in the web manga category in 2021 and was nominated for the Eisner Award in 2022.

value: Over 20 million copies, September 2026
text: By September 2026 more than 20 million copies of the manga were in circulation.
excerpt: By September 2026, the manga had over 20 million copies in circulation.
